name: 🩸Realistic Ragdoll Sandbox
desc:
🩸 REALISTIC RAGDOLL SANDBOX 🩸

Every hit has real physics. Shoot, swing, punch and throw, and watch them crumple, fly and fall apart.

🔫 GUNS & MELEE: Pistols, rifles, shotguns, a minigun and more. Bats, swords, axes, and knives you can throw. Cut limbs off with sharp weapons.
👊 FISTS: Punch, heavy punch, grab, or clinch someone and keep swinging.
💀 SLOW-MO KILL CAM: Land a headshot and you might catch the bullet going in, with an X-ray view.
⚡ POWERS: Stop time, super speed, laser eyes, sorcery, fire, or turn into a Giant or an Alligator.
🎯 TRIALS: Skyscraper raid, home invasion, club and store missions. Can you get S+?
🚗 VEHICLES & DRONES: Tanks, flying cars and attack drones.
🌍 MAPS: Baseplate, Forest, Laboratory and more, plus disasters and a building sandbox.
👥 MULTIPLAYER: Up to 10 players.

Works on PC, phone and controller. 👍 Like the game for updates!

llm.loop: pick weapons and powers in a ragdoll sandbox -> shoot, slash and punch NPCs -> complete trials/missions for ranks -> earn gems for more weapons/powers
llm.objectives: wreck NPCs and earn S+ ranks in trials
llm.progression: gems, weapon and power unlocks, trial ranks
llm.instructions: like for updates; shoot, swing, use powers, try trials
unique: x-ray slow-mo kill cam and dismemberment
llm.thumbnails: first-person guns in blank maps, skeleton x-ray icon
llm.complexity_notes: first-person weapons, ragdoll physics, many modes and maps
